task_title: INT-CI-036 (verify-only): test-counts.json tracks the live suite on main and CI is green
task_criteria: Criterion 1: a fresh 'pnpm test:run' at origin/main 57f58cf9 reports 255 test files / 2124 tests (all passing), and 'bash scripts/sync-agents-md-counts.sh --check <that fresh vitest output>' exits 0 with 'test-counts.json test counts match live suite'.

Criterion 2: the manifest is maintained by the repo's own writer in the commits that moved the suite, never hand-typed after the fact: 'git log -p -- test-counts.json' shows 252/2094 -> 253/2098 (a4e1b660, PERF-001 added a suite) then 254/2108, 255/2117 and 2124, each riding the commit that added the tests.

Criterion 3: the drift the row cites is closed on main — the red CI run failed precisely at the 'Assert test-counts.json matches live suite' step on f327db24, and the current tip 57f58cf9 has a green CI run whose 'test' job includes that same assert step (.github/workflows/ci.yml:99-100).
